domain: The same 16 already-opened Task33 v3 active one-compartment, four-observed-synapse, 40-ms trajectories. Diagnostic reuse only; no independent generalization claim.
nonexistent_arm: A learned voltage updater does not exist in the current Task33 architecture; the roadmap's formula-state/learned-voltage arm is explicitly not instantiated or silently replaced.
current_decomposition: For each candidate at each time, compute I(V_teacher,S_teacher), I(V_teacher,S_model), I(V_model,S_teacher), I(V_model,S_model) with the same analytic current equations and channel parameters. Report state-only, voltage-only, interaction, and combined errors for each channel and total. This algebraic decomposition is exact but not a claim of independent causal effects of trajectories.
decision: Task34 is diagnostically complete only if the Task33 baseline is reproduced within tolerance for all six frozen candidates, the privileged arms run on all 16 trajectories without retraining/selection, and the exact current decomposition identity passes. Report contrasts even when no component dominates. Do not use teacher-privileged arms to select a deployable checkpoint or claim a new independent performance confirmation.
